text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to your advice...
Sweep-san hasn't stalked me
ever since.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love had previously mentioned being followed
and watched by Sweep Tosho. That trouble seemed
to have been resolved, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No.
Please don't worry...
It's just the usual for me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Still!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Eep... A-Ah, Sweep-san.
What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Never mind that, just come with me!
I, the magical girl Sweepy, have prepared
the absolute best "prey" for you!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What is all this...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's tomato juice and cranberry juice!
Of course, it's not just ordinary juice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's magic juice made from a special recipe
I got from Grandma.
Go on, pick whichever one you like!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It looks delicious, but
why are you giving this to me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why? Because... I noticed your thirst, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! S-Sweep-san...
Um, I...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It's no big deal.
Don't go getting all weird and thankful!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You'll probably need regular doses, but...
it should quench your thirst at least a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So... come on, drink up already!
I went out of my way to make sure the color is red, just like the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san... Ah, how sweet of you.
But is it really alright? For me to accept
such kindness...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love hesitated.
Since it was offered with good intentions, I looked down at the juice on the table—
choice_data_list: The tomato juice looks really fresh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right.
Such a beautiful red...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
I picked out the freshest ingredients!
Not that I did it just for you or anything!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Thank you, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
A gentle tartness and natural sweetness...
It is delightfully chilled, caressing my throat as it goes down...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What a soothing flavor.
It spreads through my whole body, making all the tension melt away from my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
! See?!
Besides tomato, it's got spinach and other stuff mixed in too!
Don't worry, it's packed with plenty of iron!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My... how healthy.
Thank you so much, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...However, why did you go so far out of your way for me?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Because I'm a witch.
A vam... well, you and I aren't completely unrelated creatures, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her nearly slipping up with "vam..."
Her concern over iron intake.
The bright red juice prepared on the table.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, if you ever have trouble from now on,
just tell me!
Got that?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
Thank you, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Witches are remarkably
caring towards their comrades, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, I grasped the whole picture.
Deciding against pointing it out, I simply watched over
the two of them looking so happy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a sweet... sweet aroma.
How utterly fragrant it is.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's not just the scent that's good!
It's packed with iron, and I made it extra sweeter
than the recipe said so it melts all your fatigue away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you wanna taste test it too?
Go ahead, there's plenty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Handed a cup, I take a sip.
...It is indeed sweet. On top of the fruit's natural sweetness,
the sugar makes a very strong impression. This might be a bit too――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Delicious...
Ah, I feel so fulfilled...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Pure bliss...
It feels as though all my stress is vanishing away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ! The magic worked, didn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it truly tastes like magic.
As if my heart has regained its serenity...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not *like* magic, it IS real magic!
Grandma truly is amazing!
To even know magic that works on vampires――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-It's nothing!
Don't worry, I won't tell a soul!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vampire――... I see.
From the flow of events so far,
I had wondered if that might be the case, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but chuckle softly
at Sweep Tosho's
adorable misunderstanding.
